Bangladesh maul Nepal to win maiden SAFF U-20 Championship crown
Published on: August 28, 2024
Bangladesh wrote a new chapter in South Asian football history on Wednesday
as they defeated hosts Nepal 4-1 in the final at the ANFA Complex in Lalitpur to
win their maiden SAFF U-20 Championship title.
Mirajul Islam scored a brace, Rabby Hossen Rahul added the third and Piash
Ahmmed Nova rounded off a ruthless victory with their fourth goal as the Bengal
Tigers finally got hands on the trophy nine after the inception of the
championship tournament.

Published on: August 28, 2024
Bangladesh wrote a new chapter in South Asian football history on Wednesday
as they defeated hosts Nepal 4-1 in the final at the ANFA Complex in Lalitpur to
win their maiden SAFF U-20 Championship title.
Mirajul Islam scored a brace, Rabby Hossen Rahul added the third and Piash
Ahmmed Nova rounded off a ruthless victory with their fourth goal as the Bengal
Tigers finally got hands on the trophy nine after the inception of the
championship tournament.
